compute_nat_loss: compute the non-autoregressive translation loss with label smoothing for a given model output and targets
forward_nat_criterion: run the forward pass of the NAT loss criterion to compute loss, sample size, and logging outputs
reduce_nat_metrics: aggregate logging outputs from data parallel training and log loss, nll_loss, and perplexity metrics
review_nat_loss_class: review the LabelSmoothedDualImitationCriterion class and its loss computation methods for non-autoregressive models
refactor_nat_loss_smoothing: refactor the NAT loss criterion to customize label smoothing behavior for dual imitation training
